findings.heading: Suggested packages / 推奨パッケージ
findings.proposition: The Japanese states that the pacman and masking material is in numbered section '3.7 Packages' of the R basics chapter; the English only says 'the [R basics] section on packages' and gives no section number.
findings.reader_consequence: A Japanese reader navigates to a hard-coded section number instead of the named section. The number is a stale-prone hard reference: R basics currently has Packages as its seventh numbered section, but any added or removed section, or a change in chapter order, silently sends the reader to the wrong place, and the English text carries no such number to keep it in sync.
